title: Recover reversibility through counter direction rather than an acquired adjoint
statement: For a reversible native kernel, mixing the two counter directions gives a reversible endpoint receiver at the same bounded positive-call interface. This needs no physical inverse or hidden adjoint, but the native reversibility premise remains essential to this stronger conclusion.
